bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Acute sympathetic stress triggers adrenaline and cortisol release, while slow 4-second diaphragmatic breathing activates the parasympathetic vagus nerve brake.
core_mechanism_bullets: Acute sympathetic stress triggers adrenaline and cortisol release, while slow 4-second diaphragmatic breathing activates the parasympathetic vagus nerve brake.
Adolescents require 8 to 10 hours of nightly sleep across 90-minute REM and slow-wave cycles to consolidate hippocampal memory and regulate amygdala reactivity.
